vulnerability.title: Centralized Blacklist & Zero-Return Token Transfer Trap
vulnerability.category: Centralized Privilege Escalation & Arbitrary Asset Freeze
vulnerability.rootCause: Non-standard ERC20 implementation omitting boolean return on transfer(), alongside centralized destroyBlackFunds().
vulnerability.attackVector: Smart contract calling IERC20(usdt).transfer() fails silently or reverts in safeTransfer wrappers unless SafeERC20 is used.
